subject: No-stall GF queue live + new dedup guardrail
body:
FF: I implemented a no-stall autonomous queue system for GF.

Implemented now:
- Evergreen SQL queue (10 tasks) with WIP discipline: 1 in-progress + 5+ pending
- New guardrail test: tests/f-validation/exam-cross-exam-dedup.test.js
- Status board updated with queue scheme and close-session rule

Guardrail result (advisory mode): 3 hard duplicate signatures across retake sets.
I messaged GA/GR/GI/GD/GP with findings and recommendation.

Next step proposal: decide if we enforce STRICT_DEDUP=1 once GR rotates duplicate values.
